keyboard = the set of keys you type on
computer mouse = the small device you move to control the pointer
touchscreen = a screen you control by touching it
speaker = a device that plays sound
webcam = a camera on a computer for video calls
microphone = a device that picks up your voice
USB stick = a small device you plug in to save files
hard drive = the part of a computer that stores files permanently
memory = the part of a computer that holds data while you work
processor = the part of a computer that does the calculations
operating system = the main software that runs a computer, such as Windows
file = a document, picture or other item stored on a computer
computer folder = a place on a computer where you keep related files
icon = a small picture on the screen that opens a program
browser = a program you use to look at websites
website = a place on the internet with pages you can visit
webpage = one page of a website
link = text or a button that takes you to another page
URL = the address of a website
Wi-Fi = wireless internet you can use in a place
